jobs.title: Account Manager (Zurich)
jobs.description:
LumApps is now more than just an Employee Experience Platform — it is an AI-powered Employee Hub that supports companies in their digital transformation of communication, collaboration, and engagement with their customers, partners, and above all their employees.
 Our platform is a proven leader in this dynamic market with a truly unique vision and product. It has been deployed by Fortune 500 clients around the world and is delivering meaningful business benefits. LumApps is identified as a leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Intranet Packaged Solutions as well as in Intranets Forrester Wave, and regularly selected for the French Tech Next40/120 program.
 ✨ In 2025, LumApps strengthened its leadership position by partnering with Beekeeper , a pioneer in frontline employee experience solutions. This strategic collaboration expands our reach and impact across all types of workers — from HQ to the frontline.
 Our mission: To make people feel that they belong and have a purpose.
 To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:
 🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,
 🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,
 🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,
 🎯 Help companies reduce turnover, accelerate employee onboarding, better collaborate and share knowledge, and even improve their customer experiences.
 With a team of over 600 Lumies spread across 11 offices (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, London, Barcelona, Hamburg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Krakow), we support large enterprises all around the world. Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.

If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things" , "say what you mean, do what you say" , "one team, same mission" , "always be evolving" : apply now!

*Team*
 The Account Manager is equal parts relationship management, sales, and client satisfaction. You will be responsible for owning a portfolio of accounts, executing renewals contracts, and upsell opportunities. We believe that keeping our existing customers is equally as important as acquiring new ones. This role will manage an assigned set of customers with a focus on maintaining and growing renewal rates and establishing relationships with a focus on retention and identification of upsell and expansion opportunities. You will work with the Customer Success teams to identify growth opportunities and provide insights that improve future outcomes. You not only ensure our customers are set up for success, but also maximize the total revenue.

Your ability to clearly articulate our value proposition, sustain and renew subscriptions, resolve customer issues/problems, and effectively manage your time will be well rewarded.

*Missions*

• Own the renewals process and collaborate with internal resources (Customer Success, Account Executives, Sales Ops…) to develop comprehensive 'win' strategies for renewals

• Develop and execute negotiation strategies for medium and large account renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust

• Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management and commercial capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure

• Develop innovative ways to retain escalated clients and provide them with viable renewal options, including but not limited to negotiating pricing and/or contract duration

• Identify cross-sell/up-sell opportunities and make them happen

• Responsible for creation of renewal order forms and proposals

• Leverage Salesforce, Planhat & Clari to maintain an accurate pipeline and foreca st

*Skills*

• Experience in sales, account management, or account expansion

• Native German and fluent in English

• A minimum of 3+ years of relevant SaaS work experience

• Strong business acumen and ability to analyze data to address customer situations

• Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships

• Organizational and time-management skills

• Self-starter, eager to learn and not afraid to seek out expertise of others around you to adapt and perfect your work. Flexibility to work independently and within a team environment

• Knowledge of market research and negotiating principl es

*Bonus Points*

• Experience in a high growth company

• Bachelor degree in Economics, Marketing, or simil ar

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps
 We’re proud to offer a work environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered. Here’s a peek at what we offer:
 🏡 Hybrid work model – 2 to 3 days at the office
 🕒 25 days of annual leave
 🛡️ Pension scheme plan with 3 options to choose from
 🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties
 💻 Equipment

We aim to celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.

If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things" , "say what you mean, do what you say" , "one team, same mission" , "always be evolving" : apply now!

*Team*
 LumApps is on a mission to make every employee feel connected, informed, and empowered to do their best work – whether they’re in an office, on the shop floor, in the field, or on the go. We are building the first AI Employee Hub, helping organizations communicate, collaborate, and automate work so teams can focus on what matters most.
 We are looking for an experienced Product Director to lead one of our product tribes, Communication & Collaboration (C&C), which is the core of the LumApps platform, focused on creating and distributing engaging content, knowledge management, and real-time collaboration features for thousands of customers and millions of users. This role is critical in shaping the vision and strategy for the tribe, driving roadmap execution, and ensuring delivery of customer and business value. You will be responsible for translating strategy into action, enabling your teams to excel, and ensuring we meet adoption, usage, and satisfaction goals.
 As Product Director, you’ll be both a strategist and an operator: defining and maintaining a clear roadmap, mentoring product managers, and representing the voice of our customers and buyer personas inside and outside the company.
 You will be the Product Lead of a dynamic tribe composed of 4 teams (CMS, Social, Play, Frontline Comms), directly managing 3–4 Product Managers. The teams are distributed across our main R&D hubs, Paris, Lyon, Sophia Antipolis, Zurich, and Krakow, making this a truly international and collaborative environment. Working closely with engineering, design, and other cross-functional partners, you will play a key role in driving alignment, empowering teams, and ensuring consistent delivery across locations.

*Missions*

• Set the tribe strategy & portfolio: Define and maintain a strategic, data-informed tribe roadmap aligned to company objectives, customer needs, and market trends; make the “why” explicit and measurable.

• Drive execution across multiple teams: Ensure alignment of team-level roadmaps, sequence bets, manage interdependencies (within and across tribes), and deliver against commitments.

• Be the persona Subject Matter Expert & external voice: Act as the subject-matter expert for key buyer personas (e.g., Internal Communication and Corporate Communication managers); engage customers, prospects, and GTM teams with a compelling narrative.

• Champion discovery & validation: Institutionalize discovery, experimentation, and evidence-based decision-making (qual/quant research, product analytics, market signals).

• Lead and grow PM talent: Mentor and develop product managers; raise the bar on decision quality, prioritization, and backlog/roadmap hygiene.

• Own outcomes & transparency: Define, track, and communicate KPIs/OKRs for the domain (adoption, activation, engagement, satisfaction), and regularly share progress and trade-offs.

• Align stakeholders & resolve friction: Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, CS, Marketing, and PX; serve as the escalation point to resolve conflicts and keep delivery unblocked.

• Drive the Agentification of core Communication & Collaboration workflows: Focus on AI agents for content creation, real-time content scoring, and multi-style rewriting to amplify content quality and reach.

We will measure you based on…

• Increased adoption and engagement of Communication & Collaboration use cases across the customer base.

• A clear, data-informed tribe roadmap that accelerates LumApps’ growth in the intranet and real-time communication areas.

• Strong cross-team and cross-functional collaboration, ensuring your tribe operates effectively, aligns with company priorities, and influences the wider product strategy.

*Skills*

• Proven experience as a Product Director, Head of Product, or Senior Product Manager, leading multiple teams in a B2B SaaS environment.

• A strong balance of strategic vision and execution ability, you can craft long-term direction but also ensure delivery.

• Demonstrated success in scaling product organizations, with multi-year experience managing PMs and influencing across functions.

• Deep customer empathy and ability to act as a trusted expert for buyer personas and customer needs.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to build alignment across diverse teams and priorities.

• A track record of driving measurable product adoption, usage, and satisfaction outcomes.

• Strong understanding of go-to-market collaboration with Sales, CS, and Marketing.

• Familiarity with modern product discovery frameworks (e.g., continuous discovery habits, dual-track agile).

• Experience and strong understanding of the Internal Communication, Knowledge Management, and Real-Time Collaboration domains and use cases in both desk and frontline scenarios, and the competitive landscape

• Professional proficiency in English (C1 or equivalent).

• AI feature launch & infrastructure expertise: Proven experience launching AI-powered features (e.g., Agents, LLM-based copilots, etc.) and a strong understanding of the underlying infrastructure required to scale them (e.g., RAG systems, Agent Hubs, and AI Trust & Governance models).

Bonus Points

• Background in pricing and packaging strategy.

• Public speaking or thought leadership experience as a domain expert in your buyer persona’s field.

• French and/or German business fluency.

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps
 We’re proud to offer a work environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered. Here’s a peek at what we offer:
 If based in France:
 🏡 Hybrid work model – 2 days at the office, 3 days remote
 🕒 RTT days – ~10 extra days off per year
 💳 Meal vouchers (SWILE) + free snacks & coffee
 🧘‍♀️ Yoga classes - Take a mindful break in our Paris office
 👶 Supportive parental leave and family moments — yes, even a Christmas party for your kids !
 🛡️ Health insurance (ALAN) – 60% covered + full life & disability cover
 🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties
 💻 Equipment of your choice
 🗣️ French & English lessons , professional development & access to Leeto CSE

If based in Switzerland:
 🏡 Hybrid work model – 2 to 3 days at the office
 🕒 25 days of annual leave
 🛡️ Pension scheme plan with 3 options to choose from
 🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties

If based in Poland:
 📱 Phone & Home Internet costs reimbursement up to 80 PLN/month
 🛡️ Private health care package with Luxmed – covered for you and partially for your partner / family
 🧘‍♀️ Cafeteria benefits – monthly budget to cover sport cards or other purchases
 💰 Creative Allowance – paid as 1000 PLN gross/month
 💻 Home office set-up reimbursement up to 1000 PLN
 🎉 26 days of annual leave/year and 2 Mental Health days off per year
 Benefits listed above are part of the compensation package for contract of employment.

We aim to celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

*Team*
 The Head of Account Management, EMEA is responsible for the team managing our EMEA customers. The main objective is building strong relationships with our customers and providing significant value to their business to ensure that the portfolio renews and expands, achieving single digit gross churn rates and NRR of 120%+.
 You will partner closely with internal stakeholders (Customer Success, Customer Success Engineers, Product Managers, Marketing and Leadership) and external stakeholders (Communications, HR, IT, Operations) to drive the renewal and expansion motion.

*Missions*

• Define the strategy within your market segments to expand and renew the portfolio of customers

• Define team objectives to enable achievement of daily, weekly and quarterly targets

• Engage with internal and external executives to expand the relationships with our customers

• Actively engage in the sales process and lead from the front

• Discover customer needs, uncover concerns, and learn wider organizational initiatives through quarterly business reviews and proactive touch points

• Work collaboratively across all departments, mainly Customer Success, Marketing and Product Management

• Forecast expansion and contractions accurately on a weekly basis

• Build a healthy pipeline to ensure a coverage of 3x

• Lead your team to exceed annual quotas targets and develop their knowledge and skills

• Participation in the hiring process & developing the sales team

• Manage performance of team members

• Leverage Salesforce to maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast

*Skills*

• A minimum of 5+ years of sales leadership experience with an outstanding background in sales/account management as an individual contributor in a SaaS business.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in German (C2 level or equivalent)

• Strong understanding of sales discovery framework

• Ability to build business cases, negotiate, and develop strong relationships

• Flexibility to work collaboratively within a team and independently when needed

• Excellent communication/presentation skills with the ability to build relationships

• Organizational and time-management skills

• Proactive and self-motivated with a positive attitude

• Strong sense of curiosity with a passion for learning and helping others

• Comfortable with C-level engagement

• Strong business acumen and ability to analyze data to address customer situations

Bonus points

• Experience selling into HR, IT, Operations, Communications

• Experience selling into frontline industries (Manufacturing, Retails, Construction)

• Understanding of Challenger Customer Framework & Winning By Design principles

• Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Zoom, and Google Suite

• Spanish knowledge

• Bachelor’s degree

What we offer you

• Competitive Salary

• Personal Learning & Development Budget

• Health and Wellness Reimbursement

• Home Office Set-Up Reimbursement

• Laptop for work purposes

• Mentoring and opportunities to grow and progress within your career path

*Team*
 As a Customer Success Manager, you will own and manage a portfolio of customers and be responsible for their overall success. Your portfolio of customers will be mostly composed of Mid Market companies (MM), giving you the opportunity to learn from a reasonable number of customers in many different industries as you start your career at Lumapps. You will have at your disposal state-of-the-art technology and playbooks that will help you determine which customers to prioritize for maximum impact. As an ideal candidate you’re resourceful and persuasive, effectively showing customers how to get more value from Lumapps, Beekeeper and Comeen.

• Partner with customers to understand their strategic goals, priorities, and desired business outcomes.

• Work with them to build and execute on a success plan and key performance indicators.

• Manage a portfolio of customers post implementation, focusing on growing adoption, ensuring retention, expansion and satisfaction.

• Be the voice of your customers.

• Leverage our data on customers in your portfolio to determine which customers to prioritize and proactively reach out to address their issues.

• Interact and engage with customers on all levels (incl. VPs and Directors) and different personas (Comms, HR, IT, Operations, Frontline).

• Work closely with your Account Manager counterpart to develop a joint success plan for your customers and identify expansion opportunities.

• Drive accountability for deliverables internally and among customer teams to create a sense of ownership and get things done.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to address your customers’ needs.

*Skills*

• Language skills: Fluent in French and English are a must; Swiss German is a strong plus.

• Curiosity & Discovery: You ask sharp questions, dig into root causes, and enjoy understanding the customer’s context, goals, and constraints. You bring technical curiosity and are eager to continuously learn.

• Communication & Active Listening: You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, actively listen, and can explain complex concepts simply. You translate information and data into actionable insights and next steps.

• Empathy: You understand customer needs and emotions, navigate tough conversations constructively, handle difficult situations, and set expectations with clarity and respect.

• Business Acumen: You understand SaaS business drivers and can connect customer priorities with outcomes, value, and ROI. Experience in Customer Success, Consulting, Project Management, or Account Management in a SaaS environment is a strong plus.

• Drive: You take initiative, are hands-on, and bring a proactive “frontline-first” mentality. You’re energized by helping customers and colleagues succeed.

• Results Orientation: You stay focused on impact; driving adoption, retention, and customer outcomes. You’re solution-oriented and committed to resolving complex issues end-to-end.

• Organization & Planning: You are highly organized and structured, able to manage a customer portfolio, plan effectively, and prioritize time based on customer needs, business goals, and opportunities.

• Resourcefulness: You’re creative and pragmatic in finding answers—leveraging internal experts, documentation, and tools to move things forward efficiently (including first experience using AI tools to accelerate your work).

*Bonus Points*

• Experience in change- and project management

• Experience with discovery and questioning techniques

• Technical understanding of SaaS landscape

• Basic technical understanding of integrations / APIs Experience in conducting in-person or online workshops

 We’re proud to offer a work environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered. Here’s a peek at what we offer:
 🕒 25 days of annual leave
 💳 Pension Scheme Plan with 3 options to choose from
 🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties
 💻 Equipment
